title: Fed Holds Rates Steady and Promises Fewer Meetings
en: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark rate unchanged at 3.75 to 4 percent on Wednesday, a decision markets had widely expected but which was far from unanimous. The vote was 10 to 2, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack pressing for another quarter-point increase. In its statement the committee said inflation remains elevated and that gathering more information would help it judge the right path back to the 2 percent target. Chair Kevin Warsh told reporters that financial conditions had already tightened, while repeating his refusal to offer forward guidance. He added that the Fed would gradually reduce the number of policy meetings between 2027 and 2028. Traders now price roughly a 90 percent chance of a hike in December.
zh: 美联储周三将基准利率维持在3.75%至4%不变，这一决定虽为市场普遍预期，却远非一致通过。投票结果为10比2，理事莉萨·库克与克利夫兰联储行长贝丝·哈玛克主张再加息25个基点。声明称通胀仍处高位，收集更多信息将有助于判断回到2%目标的合适路径。主席凯文·沃什对记者表示金融状况已经收紧，同时重申拒绝提供前瞻指引。他还表示，美联储将在2027年至2028年间逐步减少政策会议次数。目前交易员认为12月加息的概率约为90%。
vocab: v. 计入价格、反映预期

title: Spain Mourns After Its Deadliest Rail Crash Since 2013
en: At least 68 people died when two high-speed trains collided in central Spain on Wednesday, the deadliest rail accident in Europe since 2013 and the second fatal crash on the same network this year. The transport minister said a Renfe train had been allowed to continue despite an active red signal, which was triggered by a computer communications failure, and it then struck an Iryo service standing on the track ahead. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez declared three days of national mourning and promised to strengthen safety rules, saying it was unacceptable for Spain to suffer two such accidents in one year. Rescue workers searched carriage by carriage while investigators tried to establish the exact sequence of events.
zh: 周三，西班牙中部两列高速列车相撞，至少68人死亡，这是欧洲自2013年以来最严重的铁路事故，也是同一路网今年发生的第二起致命事故。交通大臣表示，一列西班牙国家铁路公司（Renfe）列车在红灯亮起的情况下仍被允许继续行驶——该红灯由电脑通信故障触发——随后撞上前方停在轨道上的伊尔约（Iryo）列车。首相桑切斯宣布全国哀悼三天，并承诺强化安全规则，称一个国家在同一年发生两起此类事故是不可接受的。救援人员逐节车厢搜寻，调查人员则试图还原事件的确切经过。
vocab: n. 事件经过、先后顺序

title: Microsoft's Azure Growth Eases Fears Over AI Spending
en: Microsoft reported quarterly cloud revenue well above forecasts on Wednesday, a sign that its huge artificial intelligence investments are starting to pay off. Azure sales rose 48 percent to 33.17 billion dollars in the quarter to September, faster than in the previous period and ahead of analyst estimates. Total revenue climbed 19 percent to 92.3 billion dollars. Capital expenditure reached 45.2 billion dollars, below expectations, while free cash flow of 18.6 billion dollars beat forecasts by roughly 10 billion. Management guided to about 170 billion dollars of spending this calendar year. Shares rose about 4 percent in extended trading, a sharp contrast with Alphabet, whose free cash flow turned negative.
zh: 微软周三公布的季度云业务收入远超预期，显示其巨额人工智能投入正开始见效。截至9月的季度，Azure销售额增长48%至331.7亿美元，增速快于上一季度，并高于分析师预期。总营收增长19%至923亿美元。资本支出为452亿美元，低于预期，而186亿美元的自由现金流比预期高出约100亿美元。管理层预计本日历年度支出约1700亿美元。微软股价盘后上涨约4%，与自由现金流转负的Alphabet形成鲜明对比。

title: Iran Says It Is Ready to Quit the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty
src: 央视新闻 · 地缘局势
en: The head of the Iranian parliament's national security committee said on Wednesday that legislation allowing Iran to withdraw from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty was ready and that only political will was now required. The remark came as Qatar circulated a new draft agreement aimed at ending the war between Iran, the United States and Israel, a proposal Tehran said it was still studying. Washington has told Gulf states to prepare for a possible short but intense campaign after next month's midterm elections, and an additional Patriot air-defence system has been sent to Israel. Iran's foreign minister insisted that diplomacy still deserved a chance, with mediators trying to implement a seven-day plan.
zh: 伊朗议会国家安全与外交政策委员会主席周三表示，允许伊朗退出《不扩散核武器条约》的立法已经准备就绪，现在只差政治意愿。此番表态之际，卡塔尔正在散发一份旨在结束伊朗与美国、以色列之间战事的新协议草案，德黑兰称仍在研究该提案。华盛顿已告知多个海湾国家，为下月中期选举后可能发生的“短暂而高强度”军事行动做好准备，并已向以色列增派一套“爱国者”防空系统。伊朗外长坚持认为外交仍应获得机会，调解方正努力落实一项“七日计划”。

title: Israel's Election Leaves No Clear Winner
en: Israelis woke on Wednesday to political uncertainty after an election that produced no obvious winner. With most ballots counted, Likud remained the largest party, but Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing bloc was projected to win about 53 seats, short of the 61 needed for a majority in the 120-seat parliament. The opposition, led by former military chief Gadi Eisenkot, was projected at around 48, while Arab-led parties were set to take roughly 19. Both men claimed a path to forming a government. Final official results are due within days, and weeks of coalition bargaining, or another election, are likely to follow.
zh: 周三，以色列人在一场没有明显赢家的选举后醒来，面对政治不确定性。在大部分选票清点完毕后，利库德集团仍是第一大党，但总理内塔尼亚胡领导的右翼阵营预计仅获约53席，未达到在120席议会中占多数所需的61席。由前国防军总参谋长加迪·埃森科特领导的反对派预计获约48席，阿拉伯政党主导的党派则将获得约19席。两人都宣称有组阁路径。最终官方结果将在数日内公布，随后很可能出现数周的联盟谈判，甚至再度举行选举。
vocab: adj. 预计发生的、到期的

title: Memory Chips Are Sold Out Until 2029 as AI Demand Surges
en: SK Hynix said quarterly revenue passed 100 trillion won for the first time, reaching 104.6 trillion won, with operating profit of 83.3 trillion won and a margin of about 80 percent. The South Korean group attributed the result to insatiable demand for memory used in artificial intelligence servers. It has signed long-term supply agreements with 14 major customers, mostly cloud providers, covering more than half of its output for 2027 and 2028. Combining signed and negotiated orders, its DRAM and high-bandwidth memory capacity is effectively sold out through 2029, and the company expects demand to exceed supply until 2030.
zh: SK海力士表示，其季度营收首次突破100万亿韩元，达到104.6万亿韩元，营业利润83.3万亿韩元，利润率约80%。这家韩国集团将业绩归因于人工智能服务器所用存储芯片的需求难以满足。公司已与14家主要客户（多为云服务提供商）签署长期供应协议，覆盖其2027年和2028年产量的一半以上。将已签与在谈订单合并计算，其DRAM和高带宽内存产能在2029年前实际上已售罄，公司预计到2030年需求都将超过供应。
vocab: adj. 无法满足的、贪得无厌的
